_note: The Day 7 (Phishing) fight. Same format as response_day6.json. New kind: bait (envelopes drift across the box, each with a word drawn on it from 'flags' (the fake ones: they hurt) or 'real_words' (the real ones: touching one gives 'heal' HP and it is gone); 'fake_share' of them are fake; the harder version sends 'aim_share' of the fakes at the heart; with the counter every fake envelope carries a warning mark). disguise is the Day 2 kind (a sign-in box that turns into a hook: with the counter it is shown as a hook from the start). aimed is the Day 1 kind (a line blinks, then a key flies); its counter is the pattern's own now: a hit does only 'reduced_damage' when the counter is equipped.

comments.flawless: Joshua: Nothing got through. Recovery only needs a final check.
comments.won: Joshua: {threat} is stopped. These got through: {names}. Recovery will repair them.
comments.lost: Joshua: {threat} got through. Check your upgrades and your deck, then try again.

defenses.name: Check the Sender
defenses.works: The sender was checked, so every fake envelope carried a warning mark.
defenses.harder: No Check the Sender: nothing marks the fakes, there are more envelopes, they come faster, and some fakes head for you.

defenses.name: Staff Training
defenses.works: The staff knew what to look for, so the fake page was shown as a hook from the start.
defenses.harder: No Staff Training: the fake page looks harmless until it is almost on you.

defenses.name: Security Key
defenses.works: The stolen password was not enough: each hit did only a third of the damage.
defenses.harder: No Security Key: the stolen password does full damage, and there is less warning.

defenses.name: Report Button
defenses.works: Someone reported it early, and that gave you a little more time.

patterns.name: Lure
patterns.teach: Envelopes carry words. Read them before you touch one.
patterns.say: Look what I have for you.

patterns.name: Fake login page
patterns.teach: It looks like our sign-in page. It is not.
patterns.works_note: TRAINED: shown as what it is

patterns.name: Stolen password
patterns.teach: A password you typed is theirs now.

doom.name: NO STAFF TRAINING
doom.warn: WITHOUT THIS UPGRADE THE ATTACKS CANNOT BE STOPPED: they come as walls with no gap, Dodge does nothing, and every hit takes 30% of your HP.
doom.strike: Another person clicks and gives something away.
doom.lost: Joshua: Nobody had been taught what a fake looks like, so people kept clicking and the network fell. Train the staff.

_doom_note: doom: the upgrade this threat cannot be beaten without. When it is not equipped every pattern comes as a wall that fills the whole box (kind doomwall, no gap to dodge through), Dodge cards do nothing, and each hit takes 'percent' of the maximum HP (Block still takes its share). 'warn' is read at the start of the fight and 'lost' is Joshua's comment when the fight is lost.
